files = await list_files(".")
print(files)

import asyncio

script = """\
import PyPDF2
import openpyxl
import glob
import os

# Find the PDF file
pdf_files = glob.glob("uploads/*.pdf") + glob.glob("uploads/**/*.pdf", recursive=True)
if not pdf_files:
    pdf_files = glob.glob("*.pdf") + glob.glob("**/*.pdf", recursive=True)

print(f"Found PDF files: {pdf_files}")

if not pdf_files:
    print("ERROR: No PDF file found!")
else:
    pdf_path = pdf_files[0]
    print(f"Using PDF: {pdf_path}")

    # Extract text from the first page
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)
        num_pages = len(reader.pages)
        print(f"Total pages in PDF: {num_pages}")
        first_page_text = reader.pages[0].extract_text()

    print(f"Extracted text length: {len(first_page_text)} characters")
    print(f"Text preview (first 300 chars): {first_page_text[:300]}")

    # Create Excel file with text in a single cell
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Sheet1"
    ws["A1"] = first_page_text
    # Adjust column width for readability
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 100

    output_path = "first_page_text.xlsx"
    wb.save(output_path)
    print(f"Excel file saved to: {output_path}")
"""
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)

info = await get_file_info("./first_page_text.xlsx")
